title: 微软云增27%：股价却跌了，分析师为何看不懂？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What jumped out of you? What was most important to you? Yeah, I mean, when you look at it, Microsoft actually did fairly well both on the cloud side, as well as the capex side. So I'm not so sure why those shares are down.
segments.zh: 什么让你眼前一亮？对你来说最重要的是什么？嗯，我的意思是，你看，微软在云业务和资本支出方面都表现不错。所以我不太确定为什么股价会下跌。

segments.en: As far as service now is concerned, it looks like the guidance is a bit light on the commercial remaining performance obligations. As you mentioned, for next quarter, this quarter
segments.zh: 就ServiceNow而言，看起来商业剩余履约义务的指引有点偏低。正如你提到的，下个季度，这个季度

segments.en: they did fine at about 21%. So we need to get more color as to why they are being conservative going into next quarter.
segments.zh: 他们表现不错，大约21%。所以我们需要更多信息来了解为什么他们对下个季度持保守态度。

segments.en: But overall, I think cloud growth seems to be very strong.
segments.zh: 但总体而言，我认为云增长似乎非常强劲。

segments.en: Margin seems to be okay for Microsoft. Hey, Anurag, the service now share any agentic revenue and if so, was there any color in the print?
segments.zh: 微软的利润率似乎还可以。嘿，Anurag，ServiceNow的股价有任何代理收入吗？如果有，财报中有任何相关细节吗？

segments.en: No, I think they did a bunch of acquisitions in the last 12 months.
segments.zh: 没有，我认为他们在过去12个月里进行了一系列收购。

segments.en: I think there could be some contribution from those because there were a couple of those, you could say assets that had some exposure to Europe and some slowdown.
segments.zh: 我认为这些收购可能有一些贡献，因为其中一些资产在欧洲有一些敞口，并且出现了一些放缓。

segments.en: So I think I'm looking for perhaps some kind of a miss over there on that regard. But at the same time, when service now has a history of going and talking about
segments.zh: 所以我认为我可能在寻找这方面的一些不及预期。但与此同时，ServiceNow有历史表明，他们

segments.en: their forward guidance being a little bit lower and then beating that number up almost every quarter.
segments.zh: 的前瞻指引略低，然后几乎每个季度都超过那个数字。

segments.en: I am curious, Anurag, just to get your take. And this actually is kind of a question for both you and me and Deep.
segments.zh: 我很好奇，Anurag，想听听你的看法。这实际上是给你、我和Deep的问题。

segments.en: And it gets to this idea of the positioning of some of these large language models. I mean, we've been talking about Gemini.
segments.zh: 这涉及到这些大型语言模型的定位问题。我的意思是，我们一直在讨论Gemini。

segments.en: Obviously, Microsoft rebooted Copilot or whatever you want to call it.
segments.zh: 显然，微软重启了Copilot或者随便你怎么称呼它。

segments.en: And they've kind of put out some great adoption numbers.
segments.zh: 他们公布了一些不错的采用数据。
